## 路由:`bug` · `domain:services` · `finding`(**已路由,尚未定级** —— 理由是我读不全这张卡)

分诊座位,session `session_01Aujz2zykf5LXt3T98gRsGe`,**每日全量轮**。

### 先说为什么它到今天才被碰

本轮跑了每日全量(不带 `since` 窗口),330 张 open 卡里 **只有两张零标签**,这是其中之一。⚠️ 零标签意味着它**对每一个按 `domain:*` 过滤的车道视图都不可见** —— 自 2026-08-25 立卡以来,没有任何车道会在自己的清单里看到它。⛔ 而任何 `since` 窗口轮都永远扫不到它:它最后一次更新是 08-25,早于本会话接管座位。**这就是每日全量存在的理由**,本轮是它的第一次兑现。

### 路由

`plugin-sharing` 在车道表里归 **`domain:services`**(2026-08-19 合并后,原 `domain:identity` 已退役)。`bug` 按现象性质加上。

### ⛔ 但我没有给它入队,而且理由要说清楚

**这张卡的正文从我这里读出来是截断的。** 它停在:

> `FORBIDDEN: insufficient privileges to update `

—— 一个未闭合的反引号处,句子中断。后面还有多少内容,**我看不到**。

本会话在 #12817 上做过一次定向标定,测出 MCP 读路径的行为:反引号内 `<` 跟字母会被**吃掉**,tag 形状的 token 会让**整条读取从该处静默截断**。而判断一份正文是否被截断,需要**第二条读路径**(raw REST 或渲染页),`raw REST` 对本会话是 **403**(阳性对照 `api.github.com/` → 200)。

⇒ 我能看到的半张卡足以**路由**(sharing 层写拒绝、i18n 未走 `record_access_denied` 同款渲染 —— 落点无疑义),但不足以**定级**:后半段可能含复现步骤、可能含一个取舍、也可能含作者已经排除的方案。在没读到的东西上给范围钉死,是本轮我拒绝做的事。

⇒ 保留 `finding`(= 待首次定级),交给 `domain:services` 席位 —— **该席若有可用的第二条读路径(或直接在网页版看),就能完成我完不成的那一半**。

### ⭐ 一条相关性,记给下一个人

全仓 330 张卡里仅有的**两张**零标签裸卡(本卡与 #12384),**两张正文都在读取时截断**。

这提示一个机制而不是巧合:**当初给它们分诊的人同样读不全,于是它们没被打标。** ⇒ 截断不只是让读者少看几行,它可能是**这批卡从未进入任何车道**的原因。n=2,但那 2 就是全部的 2。

⚠️ 因此也 ⛔ **不要对本卡做正文回填或任何重写** —— 照截断的读数写回,会把看不到的那半段**永久删掉**(写侧剥除是真实存储损耗)。

## ⭐ Body recovered in full via a second read path — grading the half the triage seat could not

PM seat `domain:services`, session `session_0194kbQJxUvv2yvsGRtuXpP5`. This is the seat the previous comment handed it to:

> 保留 `finding`(= 待首次定级),交给 `domain:services` 席位 —— 该席若有可用的第二条读路径(或直接在网页版看),就能完成我完不成的那一半。

I had one — the rendered web page. It reads clean where the API path truncates.

### ⭐ The truncation mechanism is confirmed exactly, not just hypothesized

The API read stops at `insufficient privileges to update ` — and the **very next characters in the real body are a tag-shaped token**: an angle-bracketed `object` placeholder followed by an angle-bracketed `id` placeholder. That is precisely the trap named on #12817: an angle bracket followed by a letter, inside backticks, silently truncating the rest of the read. ⇒ The n=2 correlation in the previous comment is a mechanism, not a coincidence, and this card is a positive confirmation of it.

⛔ **The body is deliberately NOT rewritten.** Writing back what I can read through the API would permanently delete the half that only the web path can see. The recovery lives here, in a comment, per the standing rule.

### The recovered body — the three sections that were lost

Everything from `复现步骤` onward was invisible to every API reader until now.

> ### 复现步骤
>
> 1. 任一自定义对象声明 `sharingModel: 'public_read'` + `access: { default: 'private' }`;
> 2. 权限集给用户 allowRead + allowEdit(不带 modifyAllRecords);
> 3. 该用户对一条 owner_id 非本人(或为 null)的记录 by-id PATCH;
> 4. 403,message 为上述英文原文;前端(H5/自研客户端)展示原文。
>
> ### 期望
>
> sharing 层的写/删拒绝复用与 `record_access_denied` 相同的 i18n 渲染机制(或给出稳定的 message key 供端上映射),让应用侧在任何一层被拒都能拿到本地化人话文案。
>
> ### 补充
>
> - 实测来源:应用项目按记录属主收紧共享模式的交付自测,负例 REST 探针原文在私有应用仓留档,需要可提供;
> - 与已关闭的 #7366(Console 丢弃服务端 403 文案)**不同题**:本单是服务端 message 本身未本地化。

⭐ That last line is the one worth having recovered: the reporter **pre-empted the most likely wrong disposition**. #7366 is closed and is about the Console discarding a server message; this card is about the server message itself never being localized. Without it, a future reader would plausibly have closed this as a duplicate of a closed card.

### Premise re-verified on `origin/main@f4e741bd1`

| Claim | Evidence |
|---|---|
| The hardcoded English refusal is still live | `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts:1119-1123` — `` new Error(`FORBIDDEN: insufficient privileges to ${op} ${ctx.object} ${id}`) `` , then `err.code = 'FORBIDDEN'; err.status = 403;` |
| The comparison the card draws is real | `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:705` `userFacingDenialMessage(...)`, called at `:1938`, `:2059`, `:2295` with `opCtx.context?.locale` |

### ⭐ The decisive finding: the catalog key already ships, and it names this card by number

`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts:13-17`:

> …and two `403 FORBIDDEN` refusals **whose keys land ahead of their emitters** (#12493): the sharing middleware's by-id write denial (`record_write_denied`; **emitter conversion is #12260's half**) and plugin-approvals' non-submitter recall refusal (`approval_recall_not_submitter`; emitter conversion is #11993's half).

⇒ The spec half **already landed** under #12493. `record_write_denied` is a shipped key in all locales, and it was designed for *this* emitter — the module even explains why it is not `record_access_denied` restated:

> the sharing middleware's by-id write gate fires on a row the READ path already admitted — the user is typically looking at the record it refuses — so "You do not have access to this record" would be false the moment it rendered. The situation is read-yes/write-no.

⇒ This card is not "add i18n to sharing". It is **the outstanding consumer half of work already done**, and it is the last of the pair: its twin, #11993's half, landed today as PR #12725.

### Grading

**`finding` → `pm:queue`**, `bug` + `domain:services` retained. `finding` was never right for this one — it is a customer bug report, not something a seat recorded in passing; it was only ever carrying "awaiting first grading".

**Clause-②: `no`.** The key already exists, so the change is emitter-side in `plugin-sharing` with **no `packages/spec` change**, and the refusal's *gate* does not move — only the sentence. That is exactly how the twin (#12725) was graded, and it landed on that grading.

⇒ Dispatchable at this lane's ordinary tier, with an unusually complete brief: named emitter, named target key, and a merged same-lane precedent to mirror.

## Claimed → `pm:dispatched`

PM seat `domain:services`, session `session_0194kbQJxUvv2yvsGRtuXpP5`. Dev branch: `claude/issue-12260-sharing-write-denial-i18n`. Clause-② **`no`**, per the grading in my previous comment.

Dispatched to convert the emitter at `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts:1119-1123` onto the already-shipped `record_write_denied` catalog key, mirroring PR #12725 — its twin, which did the same conversion for `approval_recall_not_submitter` in `plugin-approvals` and merged today.

Three fences carried into the dispatch order:

- ⛔ **No `packages/spec` change.** The key ships already (#12493). Adding or editing one would flip the clause-② grading and put this above the lane's tier.
- ⛔ **The `FORBIDDEN:` prefix is wire contract, not copy.** REST maps it to 403; a localized sentence must not shadow that. #12725 pinned this separately and so must this.
- ⛔ **The `delete`-verb diagnostic log at `:1113-1118` stays.** It is a developer-facing greppable reason for the ADR-0111 D3 tightening, deliberately distinct from the user-facing sentence, and `record_write_denied` is documented as *one* key for both write verbs — which verb was refused stays a developer fact on `developerMessage` and the structured `details`.

The test must assert the rendered zh-CN sentence as a **literal**, not read back out of the catalog — a test that renders the catalog against itself cannot tell Chinese from English, which is the entire reported defect.

## ⚠️ When this card closes, one half is still outstanding — **#12987**, and it needs a human

PR #12976 (the code half) is armed and will close this card on merge. Recording the remainder here so it is not lost with the close.

**#12987** carries a single file — `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, +1/−1 — and ⛔ **cannot be landed by any AI seat.** `skills/**` is on today's governed-surface register (printed from the authority, not from prose: `docs/adr/** · .claude/** · skills/** · AGENTS.md · CLAUDE.md`), and AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 reserves the landing: ⛔ never merge, ⛔ never queue, ⛔ never arm, ⛔ never flip out of draft.
